findings.text: Exposes a fault decision service where a caller supplies an attribute bundle plus a size, with an extended form accepting warning control flags and a usercopy helper that checks a dedicated bundle using unit size.

Exposes setup helpers that publish fault controls through a filesystem directory and through a configuration group, creating the directory on demand and wiring a caller supplied group object with its type.
Exposes index based searches over bitmaps for earliest, subsequent, latest, ranked, random and byte aligned clump occurrences, with combined and complemented inputs and with byte order swapped views.
Exposes text to value helpers for truth values, integers and wide integers, plus a generator that advances a four part state and returns the combined output.

A failure decision requires every enabled gate to accept: per task countdown when present, nonzero likelihood, optional task marker, remaining allowance, stack acceptance, available budget, spacing counter and a random draw below the likelihood threshold; on acceptance a diagnostic may emit and the remaining allowance decrements unless marked unlimited.

When running in task context with a nonzero per task counter, the stack is examined first and a negative stack verdict vetoes; otherwise the counter decrements and only arrival at zero proceeds toward failure while any positive remainder allows.

Stack acceptance uses a depth limit and two address intervals: an empty require interval starts as accepted, a zero depth or empty filters short circuit, any rejected address vetoes, and any required address confirms; when filtering is disabled acceptance is unconditional.

Directory creation publishes controls for likelihood, spacing, remaining allowance, budget, verbosity, rate limit interval and burst, plus task filtering, with additional depth and interval controls when stack filtering is enabled; files use owner read write regular mode and the parent directory reference is retained in the bundle.

Configuration attributes exchange decimal text terminated by newline for unsigned, boolean and counter values, parsing with base autodetection and assigning only on successful parse; failures propagate the parse error and successes report the input length, while depth and hexadecimal views share the same store path with clamping or width sensitive display.

First and next searches scan whole words from the start or from a masked starting word and report the size when no matching bit exists or when the start lies beyond the range; a backward scan from a masked final word likewise reports size when empty; ranked searches subtract whole word weights before locating within the target word with tail masking.

Clump lookup advances to the next set bit, returns size when none exists, otherwise aligns down to an eight bit boundary and returns that boundary after loading the corresponding byte; random selection returns size when empty, the sole position when exactly one bit is set, and otherwise a uniformly chosen ranked position.

Truth parsing rejects null input, decides from the leading character with a two character sequence for the on and off spellings, and reports invalid input otherwise; integer parsing delegates to wide parsing with range narrowing, while wide parsing handles an optional leading minus with overflow checks on both signs.

Each generator step evolves four unsigned components with distinct shift pairs and masks and returns their exclusive combination; a fault helper reduces that output modulo one hundred using a per processor state.

Benchmark helpers time repeated sweeps that clear or advance through a large bitmap using each search flavor and a zero area scan, exercising both a densely randomized bitmap and a sparsely populated one, and the initialization entry reports a retryable error so the suite can be rerun without unload.

Random draws for fault decisions pin the current processor while borrowing its generator state and release the pin immediately after producing the value, preventing migration during the mutable state access.

Decision states progress from per task gating through global likelihood, task marker, allowance, stack, budget, spacing and random draw toward either allow or fail; the fail state optionally logs subject to verbosity and rate limiting before consuming one allowance unit.

The self test moves from dense random population through timed sweeps of each search, then to sparse population followed by the same sweeps, ending in a terminal error return that preserves the module for another run.

Directory setup acts as the debug filesystem entry for a fault bundle, failing with the directory error when creation fails and otherwise installing all tunable files before returning the new directory.
Group initialization acts as the configuration entry for a fault bundle, seeding the shared random state once and binding the caller group to its name and attribute type.
The benchmark initialization entry acts as a boot time self test entry that builds test bitmaps, runs timing loops and exits with a non success code to permit manual repetition.
Spacing and likelihood controls are plain fields updated without atomicity or locking, so concurrent fault decisions can race on the counter increment and observe torn or stale tuning values.

The retained directory reference and the diagnostic path assume successful setup, so callers must not invoke the diagnostic or decision helpers on a bundle whose creation failed or whose name handle was never installed.
Maximum captured stack depth is 32 entries.
Benchmark bitmap length is 4096 times 8 times 10 bits and sparse divisor is 500.
Configuration attributes use mode 0644 for owner read write with group and other read.
Debug filesystem tunable files are regular files with owner read and write access.

A fault configuration groups a generic configuration group with its attribute bundle and is recovered from a configuration item through group conversion and container linkage; its type references a null terminated table of attribute descriptors each carrying a name, mode, owner and show and store handlers generated by a shared macro.

Generator evolution uses shift pairs six with thirteen then two with twenty seven then thirteen with twenty one then three with twelve, final shifts eighteen two seven and thirteen, and masks 4294967294 then 4294967288 then 4294967280 then 4294967168 in component order.
